request: Set up a delivery runs module: each run has a run name and a delivery date, with stops as lines (customer name and drop-off window), statuses Planned, Out for delivery and Completed, and a board of runs by status.

outcome.renderedDiff:
Publishes Board “Runs by status” for Delivery run. Stages are Planned, Out for delivery, Completed. Available moves are Complete run, Send out for delivery. Card facts are Delivery date.
New record type "Delivery run" with 3 fields:
  - State (one of "Planned", "Out for delivery", "Completed", required)
  - Run name (text, required)
  - Delivery date (date)
  It gets its own menu entry "Delivery run" with a list, a record page and a form.
  People who can use the rest of the application can create, change, archive and restore Delivery run records.
New line table "Stops" on Delivery run:
  - Line number (whole number, required)
  - Customer name (text, required)
  - Drop-off window (text)
New lifecycle for Delivery run. Records start at "Planned".
  - Send out for delivery changes "Planned" to "Out for delivery" after confirmation.
  - Complete run changes "Out for delivery" to "Completed" after confirmation.

Stored data: 2 new tables, 3 new indexes, addForeignKey. Nothing already stored is changed or removed.
Rolling back hides this change again and keeps every record entered under it.
